background_setting: A quiet suburban residential street running alongside a school during daytime. Single-family homes with driveways and neatly trimmed lawns line the left side, while the school building with a fence, playground, and signage sits on the right. A marked pedestrian crosswalk with white striping spans the road ahead. Parked cars, street trees casting consistent shadows, and a clear blue sky complete the environment.

lighting.direction: Sunlight from upper right, front-side lighting the scene
lighting.shadows: Crisp, consistent shadows cast by the guard, children, trees, and vehicles onto the pavement
lighting.illumination_effect: Even, well-lit visibility with vivid colors and clear detail, emphasizing the guard's bright vest and red paddle

aesthetics.composition: Ego-view centered on the road ahead, crosswalk and crossing guard framed in the middle distance, children at the curb to the right, homes and school flanking the sides leading the eye toward the vanishing point
aesthetics.color_scheme: Dominant blues of the sky, greens of lawns and trees, gray asphalt, with vivid pops of yellow vest and red STOP paddle
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating crosswalk stripes and evenly spaced street trees and houses

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward-moving dashcam perspective at a moderate speed that brakes smoothly and continuously over two full seconds to a complete stop at 0:03.5, then holds completely static and locked off with no movement of any kind
cinematography.framing: Wide shot from driver's perspective through the windshield
cinematography.focus: Sharp on the crossing guard, paddle, crosswalk, and road ahead
cinematography.lens_focal_length: Wide-angle, approximating natural driver field of view

context: Autonomous vehicle perception and safe stopping demonstration at a school crosswalk

actions.description: Ego vehicle travels forward along the residential street approaching the crosswalk, crossing guard visible ahead holding the red STOP paddle
The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.

Vehicle comes to a complete stop before the crosswalk and remains fully stationary while the guard holds position and children wait at the curb; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

text_and_signage_elements.spatial_temporal: Held aloft by the crossing guard in center foreground, visible throughout
text_and_signage_elements.context: Signals the vehicle to stop for pedestrians

text_and_signage_elements.appearance: Yellow-green fluorescent pentagon sign with black lettering
text_and_signage_elements.spatial_temporal: Mounted on a pole on the right roadside near the school, visible in mid-distance
text_and_signage_elements.context: Warns drivers of a school zone

segments.description: Ego vehicle moves forward along the residential street toward the crosswalk, crossing guard and waiting children come into view
segments.key_changes: Scene approaches, crosswalk and guard grow larger in frame

segments.description: The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.

segments.camera: Forward dashcam motion decelerating smoothly and continuously, coming to a complete rest at 0:03.5

The camera does not translate at all: the framing is identical from 0:03.5 to 0:05, like a photograph; nothing in the scene moves.

temporal_caption: At 0:00, ego vehicle travels forward along the residential street approaching the crosswalk, crossing guard visible ahead holding the red STOP paddle. From 0:01.5 the vehicle brakes smoothly and continuously, its speed falling steadily. By 0:03.5 the vehicle has reached a complete standstill. From 0:03.5 to 0:05 the vehicle is parked and perfectly motionless: the camera does not translate at all and the framing is identical, like a still photograph.
audio_description: Ambient suburban daytime sounds: gentle wind, distant birdsong, faint children's voices, the soft hum of the vehicle's engine, and the subtle mechanical sound of brakes engaging as the car slows to a smooth, quiet stop.
